items.context:
COMFORT WAVE emits powerful, swinging streams of larger-than-usual water drops for an ultra-comfortable, moderately intense shower that uses only a small amount of water. Mixing conventional shower spray into the flow adds pleasant stimulation.

As the standard spray type of our showers, COMFORT WAVE is the ideal choice for any time of the day which offers a refreshing, luxurious and lavish shower experience.
